name: 古汉医药
current_thesis: 古汉医药拥有老字号品牌、核心中成药品种和控制权变更后的渠道修复想象力，但2025年和2026Q1仍处亏损，商誉已全额减值，当前约19.6亿元市值已提前反映扭亏预期，因此暂不买入，仅在价格回落且收入增长、费用率下降、扣非亏损继续收窄后再评估小仓位。

position_plan.reason: 2026-07-10 price 8.19 CNY implies about 19.6bn CNY market cap while 2025 and 2026Q1 earnings remain negative.
Only a small tracking position is justified before recurring profitability is proven.
Sustained turnaround would validate the brand and channel repair thesis, but governance and concentration risks remain.

price_triggers.reason: Enter detailed buy review only if price falls into the upper end of the buy zone.
At this level the risk-reward may become attractive if financial improvement continues.
Reduce or avoid exposure if valuation expands without confirmed profitability.

review_triggers.reason: Review after the 2026 interim report for revenue growth, loss reduction, channel progress, cash flow and asset impairment.
Review after the 2026 third-quarter report for evidence of recurring profitability and expense control.
